site.audience: health-conscious grocery shoppers looking for unique, affordable food products

brief.title: Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness
brief.one_liner: A neighborhood grocery store offering unique, high-quality food products at great prices.
brief.goal: Showcase the brand's curated grocery products, seasonal favorites, and store locations to drive in-store visits and product discovery.

pages.objective: Welcome visitors with the brand story, highlight featured and seasonal products, and encourage store visits.

navigation.trigger: Our Stores link in header navigation
About Us link in header navigation

interactions.trigger: User clicks left/right arrows on featured products section
interactions.expected: Product cards slide horizontally to reveal more items

interactions.trigger: User hovers over a product category card
interactions.expected: Card scales up slightly and shows overlay with category name

interactions.trigger: User enters zip code in store locator input and clicks search
interactions.expected: Nearest store locations are displayed below the input

interactions.trigger: User enters email and clicks subscribe button
interactions.expected: Confirmation message appears thanking user for subscribing

data_display.description: A carousel of featured grocery products with images, names, and prices
Grid of product category cards linking to category pages
Key brand statistics displayed in a highlights banner section
